data.description: A resort-style community equipped with all necessary amenities right at your doorstep

data.answer: The Danah Bay developer has developed a community of like-minded individuals who value health, well-being, and connection, providing a wealth of choices and accessible luxury. With 40,000 sq m of beaches, Danah Bay offers a distinct resort-style lifestyle away from the hustle and bustle of the city. It allows residents to live in luxurious accommodations, while soaking up the sun and breathtaking views.

The homes in Danah Bay range from studio apartments to expansive 5-bedroom villas, ensuring comfort, sustainability, and effortless elegance. Nestled in the heart of Danah Bay’s prestigious beach community, the Luxury Waterfront Apartments offer breathtaking views, meticulous design, and an array of exclusive amenities. This tower is more than a residence—it's a modern haven where luxury and comfort coexist harmoniously.

Danay Bay townhouses and villas offer modern interpretations of the iconic architecture of the Greek islands and the wooden decks of boats. The villas and townhouses are available in five distinct layouts: Perla, Aqua, Azure, Alina, and Layan. The villa complex Breakwater Villas offers sweeping views, ultimate privacy, ample storage, and convenient service areas, while the townhouses are grouped in clusters of four and two.

The interiors include open-plan living, dining, and kitchen spaces, featuring modern materials and detailed craftsmanship. The luxurious 5-bedroom villas are available with direct beach access or incredible sea views, while the 3-story 3-bedroom villas and 2-bedroom townhouses provide residents with rooftop terraces. Alternatively, you can look for townhouses for sale in Dubai and Dubai luxury villas.

Buying a Property in Danah Bay

One of the key benefits of living on Al Marjan Island is the diverse range of properties available within the residential community.

The homes at Danah Bay RAK are anticipated to yield profitable returns on investment, thanks to their prime location, extensive amenities, and variety of unit types. Here are the property types with starting prices:

  • 3-bedroom villas in Danah Bay are priced from AED 2.65M.
  • The price of 4-bedroom villas start from AED 4.9M.
  • 2-bedroom townhouses in Danah Bay, Al Marjan Island, are available at the starting price of AED 1.7M.

Investors can also find apartments for sale in Danah Bay. The sales price for 1-bedroom apartments is AED 1.9M, while 2-bedroom apartments are priced at AED 2.7M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Danah Bay?

data.answer:
Life in Danah Bay offers a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and serenity. This premium beach community in Ras Al Khaimah provides residents with breathtaking sea views, modern amenities, and beautifully designed homes, ranging from luxurious villas to contemporary apartments.

The community is designed to promote a healthy and active lifestyle, featuring private beaches, outdoor swimming pools, and lush green spaces. Residents can enjoy a variety of water sports, dine at upscale restaurants, and partake in a vibrant social scene. Danah Bay’s tranquil environment, coupled with its high-end facilities, makes it an ideal place for families, professionals, and retirees seeking a peaceful yet dynamic lifestyle.

Supermarkets in Danah Bay

Residents of Danah Bay enjoy convenient access to a variety of supermarkets for their daily shopping needs. Within the community, Leptis Fresh Supermarket offers a wide range of fresh produce, groceries, and household items, providing a convenient and comprehensive shopping experience. Additionally, Zoom, located just 8 minutes away, offers a quick and easy option for essentials and snacks. These supermarkets ensure that residents have everything they need within easy reach, contributing to the convenience and comfort of life in Danah Bay.

Shopping Malls Near Danah Bay

Al Hamra Mall is in Ras Al Khaimah, about 12 minutes away from the area. The mall offers a diverse shopping experience with a variety of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Manar Mall and RAK Mall also provide residents of Danah Bay with a convenient destination for leisure and shopping.

Schools and Nurseries in Danah Bay

Families living in Danah Bay have access to several reputable schools and nurseries nearby. RAK Academy, known for its high educational standards and diverse curriculum, is a short drive away, providing quality education from primary to secondary levels.

Little Treasures Nursery offers a nurturing and stimulating environment for younger children, focusing on early childhood development. These educational institutions ensure that families in Danah Bay have excellent options for their children's education and care close to home. Another popular choice is Chubby Cheeks Nursery, about 23 minutes away from Danah Bay RAK.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Danah Bay

Residents of Danah Bay have access to excellent healthcare facilities nearby. The RAK Medical Center, located just 13 minutes away, offers comprehensive medical services and specialized care. Additionally, the Nexus Medical Center, only 14 minutes away, provides a wide range of healthcare services, ensuring residents have convenient access to quality medical care for all their health needs.

Danah Bay Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is only 30 minutes away, providing easy travel options. Nearby attractions such as Al Marjan Island and Mina Al Arab offer beautiful beaches, luxury resorts, and various leisure activities, ensuring that Danah Bay residents have the perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Danah Bay

data.answer:
In Danah Bay, residents can enjoy a variety of water sports, relax on pristine beaches, and explore scenic jogging and walking paths. The community also offers amenities like a lagoon-shaped swimming pool, gym, and nearby dining and shopping options for a well-rounded lifestyle.

Danah Bay Restaurants & Bars

Residents of Danah Bay enjoy a vibrant culinary scene with excellent dining options both within and near the community. Onsite, the Panda Grill House Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience, while the Super Breeze Bar and Restaurant provides a relaxed atmosphere for drinks and meals. Just a short 7-minute drive away, Zetouna Restaurant offers a variety of delicious dishes, ensuring residents have diverse and convenient dining options close to home.

Beaches in Danah Bay

Danah Bay is renowned for its pristine, private beaches, offering residents a serene and luxurious seaside experience. The community boasts beautiful stretches of white sand where residents can relax, sunbathe, and enjoy the stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. The beaches are perfect for a variety of water activities, including swimming, paddleboarding, and kayaking. With its clear waters and tranquil environment, Danah Bay provides the ideal setting for both leisurely beach days and active seaside adventures. The beachside amenities, including sun loungers, shaded areas, and beachside cafes, further enhance the beach experience for residents and visitors alike.

Hotels in Danah Bay

Whether you're on a long business trip, enjoying a short staycation, embarking on a journey of discovery, or seeking a wellness spa escape, our 4-star upscale hotel with 300 keys provides the perfect setting for rest and recreation.

The hotel is a masterpiece of contemporary architecture, with interiors inspired by a casual beach lifestyle and effortless sophistication. It is the meeting point of luxury and practicality, exuding a light and breezy vibe that harmonizes perfectly with the natural allure of the coast.

Bask in the relaxing splendor of uninterrupted sea views from any of the rooms or serviced apartments, thanks to the hotel’s striking crescent-shaped design. Enjoy a cold drink and a freshly tossed salad at one of the restaurants or cafes on the ground floor.

The JW Marriott Residences & JW Marriott Al Marjan Island Resort, the GCC region's first JW Marriott-branded residential property, is also located near the community.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Danah Bay

Marjan Island offers a wealth of attractions for residents and visitors, including stunning beaches, luxury resorts, and a variety of leisure activities. The island is home to several high-end hotels and resorts that provide world-class amenities, including spas, gourmet dining, and water sports facilities. For adventure seekers, there are numerous water activities, such as jet skiing, snorkeling, and paddleboarding. The island is also home to Wynn Al Marjan, the UAE’s first casino resort.

One of the things to consider before investing in Danah Bay properties is that it is not well-connected with public transportation yet. However, as it is rapidly developing, soon there will be buses and taxis easily available around the area.

How far is Danay Bay Al Marjan from the airport?

Danah Bay is 20 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Airport and 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

What is Danah Bay RAK location?

Danah Bay is strategically located in the vibrant and rapidly growing area of Ras Al Khaimah, within the prestigious Al Marjan Island development.

What is the Danah Bay handover date?

The development’s handover date is still not confirmed.

Is the Payment Plan for Investing in Danah Bay Announced?

Dubai Investments has yet to announce the official payment plan for Danah Bay. However, flexible payment options are available through third-party investors. One popular plan is the 60/40 schedule, which includes a 20% down payment to secure the property.

What Property Types Are Available in Danah Bay?

Danah Bay offers a range of property types, including apartments, townhouses, and villas, catering to different lifestyle preferences.

Can Foreigners Buy Property in Ras Al Khaimah?

Ras Al Khaimah offers foreigners the opportunity to invest in real estate throughout the entire emirate. Investors highly favored RAK, which they view as a secure region offering lucrative returns.

Is Danah Bay a Completed Project?

It is expected to be completed by Q4 2024.

data.content:
A project by Dubai Investments, Danah Bay is located on Al Marjan Island. It is a premium beach community in the UAE, offering a blend of outdoor adventure, untamed nature, and serenity. Located in Ras Al Khaimah, this idyllic retreat is the perfect escape for unwinding and is an ideal investment for either a primary residence or a holiday home in the UAE's fastest-growing tourism district.

Spanning 90,000 sq. m., Danah Bay is home to an upscale 4-star hotel. This prime beachfront community offers residents a serene coastal living experience while providing easy access to key locations and amenities.

It is conveniently situated close to major attractions such as Al Hamra Mall. The location also ensures swift connectivity to Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, making travel convenient.
